peerGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (RCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

positions.label: Price position
positions.statement: Price position — In line with comparable condos: 0.7% above its local comparables; 30 of 44 similar developments with a figure have a lower relative price (a position, not a measure of value).

positions.label: Resale activity
positions.statement: Resale activity — Around peers (58.8): 5.1 resales per 100 homes a year (24 months): higher than 29 of 51 similar developments (the same as 2). Context, not scored: resales in 91.7% of months (24 months).

rentalYield.caption: Gross yield = 12 x typical rent / typical resale price for the same size band. Before maintenance, property tax, vacancy and agent fees. Not a return on your cash. Lease: 99 yrs from 2012.

rules.peers: same class, market segment and 100 sq ft size band; original lease 99 years or longer, including freehold and 999-year (short leases excluded)
rules.range: the range from combining the middle half of rents with the middle half of prices (12 x lower-quartile rent / upper-quartile price to 12 x upper-quartile rent / lower-quartile price); not a confidence interval
rules.shortLease: Developments with leases under 99 years are excluded from standard long-lease peer groups.

householdIncome.geographyNote: Bishan planning area (Master Plan 2019), not a postal district.
householdIncome.incomeDefinition: Income is household employment income including employer CPF.
conditions: Planning areas follow Master Plan 2019
Employment income includes employer CPF and platform-worker CPF contributions
Figures are rounded to the nearest 100 and may not add up
"-" means nil or negligible
Small cells should be read with caution
GHS 2025 sample design: go.gov.sg/ghs2025-sample-design-and-variability
householdIncome.context: This describes the area, not buyers.
householdIncome.attribution: SingStat, General Household Survey 2025, table C020145 (resident households by planning area and monthly household employment income)

comparisonGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (RCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

profile.rule: Each line compares this development with its own comparison group; numbers from different groups are not comparable. There is no overall score.
profile.surroundingMarket: Surrounding market: other condo and EC developments within 2 km (straight line between development positions); new sales plus resales; subsales, cluster and other landed housing, HDB flats and this development are excluded. Competition, the quiet-area check and the Market backdrop use this same set.

lines.label: Entry price against comparable developments
lines.statement: 1-bedroom: median $915,000 ($1,848 psf, 495 sq ft; 5 resales, Oct 2025–Sep 2026); 3 comparable developments within 3 km: median $1,935 psf (range $1,871–2,149); 4.5% below; illustrative entry-price difference about $43,000 less. 2-bedroom: median $1,575,000 ($2,152 psf, 731 sq ft; 7 resales, Aug 2025–Jul 2026); 4 comparable developments within 3 km: median $2,111 psf (range $1,961–2,232); 1.9% above; illustrative entry-price difference about $30,000 more. 3-bedroom: median $2,460,000 ($2,305 psf, 1,044–1,259 sq ft; 11 resales, Jul 2025–Jun 2026); 6 comparable developments within 3 km: median $2,203 psf (range $1,882–2,437); 4.7% above; illustrative entry-price difference about $109,000 more. The entry-price difference is illustrative: the median price adjusted to the comparable median psf, for a similar-size unit. A premium or a discount is not in itself an advantage or a disadvantage.

lines.label: Sustained resale activity
lines.statement: No first resale wave in the observation period: sustained activity is the observed activity.

lines.label: MRT today
lines.statement: Upper Thomson MRT about 190 m, Bright Hill MRT about 540 m; closer than 34 of 51 similar developments (the same as 1). Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Primary schools
lines.statement: 1 within 1 km and 2 within 2 km; nearest Ai Tong School about 400 m; more than 9 of 51 similar developments (the same as 14). Straight-line distances. MOE measures distance for school admission differently.

lines.label: Everyday amenities
lines.statement: 2 supermarkets within 1 km (nearest about 310 m), more than 6 of 51 similar developments (the same as 6); nearest hawker centre Shunfu Mart about 860 m; nearest park Windsor Nature Park about 380 m. Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Future transport
lines.statement: Not yet assessed: needs official LTA evidence for planned stations.

lines.label: Recorded new-launch competition
lines.statement: 1 other condo development sold new homes within 2 km (Artisan 8, 4 new sales, about 670 m). Surrounding market, Oct 2025–Sep 2026: 32 other condo and EC developments within 2 km recorded 4 new sales and 217 resales (221 purchases); new sales were 1.8% of these purchases. Subsales (34) and this development’s own transactions are excluded. New sales as a share of local private purchases is a measure of market activity, not of supply pressure.

lines.label: Unsold inventory

missing.reason: not available until the URA-based launched-unsold measure (S3) passes the V1 local validation; no other inventory source is used

lines.statement: Not available: unsold inventory has not been validated.

lines.label: Known pipeline

missing.reason: known sites only; not a complete pipeline

lines.statement: Within 2 km: upcoming Thomson Reserve development, about 100 m. Known sites only; not a complete pipeline.

lines.label: Quiet-area check
lines.statement: Quiet area: local resales are among the lowest 30% of similar developments, so little nearby competition reflects a thin market, not an advantage. 217 resales within 2 km in Oct 2025–Sep 2026, more than 2 of 51 similar developments.

lines.label: Market backdrop
lines.statement: Condo and EC resales within 2 km: 217 in Oct 2025–Sep 2026 against 288 in Oct 2024–Sep 2025 (−24.7%). Planning-area private resales −23.4%. Observed transactions, not a prediction.
